title: Geodesics on an ellipsoid of revolution (GeographicLib documentation)
claims: The geodesic direct and inverse problems on an ellipsoid give the shortest curve (geodesic) between two positions; the inverse problem returns distance and azimuth.
GeographicLib's geodesic classes provide accurate solutions for the WGS84 ellipsoid, and series solutions are recommended for most geodetic applications.
